description: The Census Hub is Eurostat's dissemination system for the harmonised EU population and housing censuses, in which the national statistical institutes supply cross-classified tables (hypercubes) defined by European census legislation. The data browser read on 2026-09-28 offers the CENSUS2021 domain for 31 countries of residence (EU and EFTA), at national, NUTS 2, NUTS 3 and municipal (LAU) level, with topics such as sex, age, household and family status, activity, occupation, industry, place of work, education, size of locality, place of birth, citizenship, year of arrival, residence one year before and housing arrangements; the census counts the whole population and the housing stock at one reference date, typically every ten years. Access is through the web browser, where a user selects data, lays out the table and downloads it; Eurostat data are free to re-use under its copyright notice with the source acknowledged. Caveats: methods differ by country (traditional field census, registers or both), cells are protected for statistical confidentiality, and the 1 km grid census data are published separately. For infrastructure simulation it gives the population, households and dwellings exposed to hazards and the demand base for capacity planning at small-area level. Related records are the national census tables catalogued per country, such as the Slovak and Lithuanian 2021 census records.
